info.name: VELoop Rewards - Daily Streak API
info.description:
Two independent folders:

* **Production / Live Flow**: public endpoints only; runs against the deployed API or locally. `newman run <file> --folder "Production / Live Flow" --env-var baseUrl=https://<api>/api`
* **Local QA Only**: needs a local backend with NODE_ENV=development and ENABLE_DEV_TOOLS=true (uses /api/dev/*, which returns 404 in production).

Both folders need seeded data (`npm run seed`). Running the whole collection locally executes both.

item.name: Production / Live Flow
item.description: Runs against any environment, including the deployed production API (set `baseUrl`). Registers a fresh user each run, claims Day 1 through the CPA flow and runs the security/negative tests that do not need time travel. Requires the seeded demo users for the cross-user test. Contains no /api/dev requests.

exec: pm.test('7 reward cards from DB config', () => pm.expect(d.rewards).to.have.length(7));

item.name: Claim Day 1 - start (with fake reward/streak/user fields)

exec: const s = pm.response.json().claimSession; pm.test('day 1', () => pm.expect(s.day).to.eql(1)); pm.collectionVariables.set('sessionId', s.id);

request.description: All tampering fields are ignored (and audit-logged as TAMPERED_REQUEST); only the backend-configured reward is granted.

item.name: [neg] Other user cannot confirm this session

exec: // Wait for the server-side CPA demo window (cpaDemoSeconds = 5).

item.name: Local QA Only
item.description: Requires the LOCAL development environment: backend started with NODE_ENV=development and ENABLE_DEV_TOOLS=true. These requests use /api/dev/* to reset the demo account and simulate time passing (24h unlock, missed day). In production the /api/dev routes are intentionally not mounted and return 404, so do not run this folder against the live API.

exec: pm.test('Day 1 available', () => { const s = pm.response.json().streak; pm.expect(s.currentDay).to.eql(1); pm.expect(s.claimable).to.eql(true); });

request.description: Clears the demo user streak so the run is repeatable. The wallet ledger is never deleted.

exec: // Wait for the server-side CPA demo window (cpaDemoSeconds = 5).

request.description: All tampering fields are ignored (and audit-logged as TAMPERED_REQUEST); only the backend-configured reward is granted.

item.name: [neg] Other user cannot confirm this session

exec: // Wait for the server-side CPA demo window (cpaDemoSeconds = 5).
pm.test('fake reward ignored: +10 VEs', () => { const t = pm.response.json().transaction; pm.expect(t.amount).to.eql(10); pm.expect(t.currency).to.eql('VES'); });
pm.test('streak reset to Day 1', () => { const s = pm.response.json().streak; pm.expect(s.status).to.eql('RESET'); pm.expect(s.currentStreak).to.eql(0); pm.expect(s.currentDay).to.eql(1); });
